RoHelper 1.0.1

Events and timers across all nine supported games: 26 event references and 38 shared timer presets, updated through GitHub.
Account-specific cooldowns, server timers, shared spawn/restock clocks, pause/resume, notifications and saved playtime timers. Unknown schedules remain clearly marked; community timings include their sources.
Add-account option descriptions now appear below their titles.
Includes the expanded 153-achievement catalog. Existing accounts, inventories, achievements and personal timers stay in local AppData.
